name: silo_withdraw
summary: Take items of one prefab out of an SDB Silo straight into a holder's slots, with the silo's own bookkeeping, front of the store first. Dry run by default; confirm to do it.

help.text: Name it by prefab_name or prefab_hash; quantity counts items (a stack its quantity, anything else 1), at most what the silo holds. A stack entry holding nothing is pooled: the amount goes into stacks, the last entry keeping the rest. A thing holding things, a non-stack and stored food move whole, contents and all, one empty slot each; food comes out rotten, as from the silo's export. If a game call fails part way, what it did not make stays in the silo. Host only.
help.keys: dry_run, silo {reference_id, prefab_name, display_name}, on_off, powered, to {reference_id, prefab_name, display_name}, quantity, taken [{index, quantity, left, whole, children}], placed [{where, slot, quantity, reference_id}], stock {prefab_name, display_name, before, change, after}, count {before, after, capacity}.

delivery.text: to_id is the holder (default the player); to_slot a slot index or "auto" (default). On a player, auto tops up matching stacks anywhere in the inventory, then makes new stacks in empty slots that take the item (never the body slots unless named by index); on anything else its own slots; never a hidden slot. A whole entry needs an empty slot that takes it. What does not fit is no_room and nothing happens, unless allow_ground puts the rest on the ground a metre in front of the holder.

reply.text: {dry_run, silo, on_off, powered, to, quantity, taken [{index (the entry's place in the store before), quantity, left (what the entry keeps), whole, children}], placed [{where (merged, slot or ground), slot {id, slot}, quantity, reference_id (null in a dry run)}], stock {before, change, after} for the prefab, count {before, after, capacity} in entries}. A real run reads stock and count back from the silo.

prefab_name.description: The item to take, as container_contents names its entries (ItemIronIngot).

prefab_hash.description: The item to take, by prefab hash (as the silo's IC stack gives it).

quantity.description: Items: a stack counts its quantity, anything else 1.

to_id.description: The holder that gets the items; default the player.

to_slot.description: A slot index of to_id, or "auto" (default).

allow_ground.description: Put what does not fit on the ground in front of the holder. Default false.

dry_run.description: Default true: check and report only.

confirm.description: true with dry_run false to withdraw.
